rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) names the item. Text cells and combs: caption left of or above the cell, or the column header of a Part III row. Amounts: the 11-slot peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right form one money_joins pair. Booleans: X in the box immediately left of the printed option (Amended, Withheld, Category). TIN rows: three TIN combs and the 5-slot branch comb carry catalog name stamps and are filled by name, so they take no join. Part III dates are three combs per row under one layout date key and stay blank. Layout keys with no printed cell on this sheet (txtLineBus, txtDate20-23, ebirOnline*, txtFinalFlag, txtEnroll, driveSelectTPExport, txtOthers) have no cell to fill. Since #113: Part III dates print through date_joins (one writer date split across the MM, DD and YYYY combs of its payment row); every other value has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
